_comment: API and operation cases for energy-lives (backend.md). Expected values were produced by running the rules of README section 3 on a small in-memory model; stacks A, B and C have not run them. `at` is the server clock for that step. `as` is the account id in the verified session. Steps with `internal` call the in-process operation named there. `expect.body` lists the fields that must be present with these values; absent fields are not checked. The `merge-takes-the-higher-value` case gives the guest account a boost until 12:10 in the model; its stored meter sits in `setup.other_account`.

cases.note: on_start: charged at start, kept through confirm and win.
The same attempt id returns the original; another meter code with the same id conflicts.
Value 0: rejected with the time to the next point; nothing is stored.
on_fail: start reserves; fail charges; the reservation shows in available.
on_fail: a win releases the reservation, no charge.
Two devices race for the last unit: one 201, one 409.
on_fail: the reservation makes the second device fail to start.
A start that failed to begin: refund of the charge, replay changes nothing.
Confirm window 3600 s. Full meter, spend, regenerate to full, cancel: nothing to restore.
No confirm within 120 s: the next touch refunds as of 12:02:00.
A confirmed attempt is not cancellable.
Boost until 13:00: the start costs nothing and is marked boost_free.
Limit 2: the third start-failure that day is not refunded.
on_fail, confirmed at 12:00:01, TTL 3600: charged as of 13:00:01, not as of the later read.
Meter 2 of 5 at 2 gems per missing unit: cost 6, balance 25 -> 19, replay spends once.
Expected 4, actual 6: no charge, the new quote comes back.
At the cap: no charge.
Balance 1 gem: rejected by the ledger, meter unchanged.
The ledger spend applied, the credit failed: the entry is pending; the next read re-drives it, the meter reaches 5 and the ledger is charged once.
A verified ad callback with transaction_id tx-9001: +1; a repeat of the callback adds nothing.
Five grants fill the day; the sixth is refused as daily_limit.
Streak reward of 8 at 5 of 5: ceiling 10, applied 5, unapplied 3; the replay returns the same.
Boost with 1800 s left plus 3600 s: ends 13:30.
Remaining 85000 s (cap 86400): only 1400 s fit, 2200 s are reported unapplied.
Two bought boosts of 3600 s: ends 13:00, then 14:00.
Server value 2; two offline attempts replayed in order are both accepted; a repeat of the batch changes nothing.
Server value 1 (another device spent): the first attempt is accepted, the second is rejected and stays rejected.
Guest 3 (boost until 12:10) into the account at 1: value 3, boost kept; replay changes nothing.
